sn48.8:1.1: This discourse offers brief expansions of each of the five faculties in terms of standard doctrinal groups of four. This complements the definitions in the next discourses. | The same analysis is applied to the five powers at AN 5.15.
sn48.8:1.5: Faith in the Buddha, Dhamma, Saṅgha, and unshakeable ethics (SN 12.41, SN 55.1). | By this means “ethics” are included in the faculties although not explicitly mentioned. We have noted the same thing for the awakening factors (SN 46.1) and mindfulness meditations (SN 47.3).
sn48.8:1.14: As usual, samādhi (“immersion”) is defined in terms of jhāna (“absorption”; see SN 53.1–12).
